checks.text: The page shows the heading "Stopwatch App" and the text "0:00.00" in the time display.
Clicking the button "Start" changes the button label to "Stop" and the time display begins counting up; after waiting 2 seconds, the time display shows a value greater than "1:50.00".
While the timer is running, clicking the button "Lap" adds a list item that contains "Lap 1" and a duration string matching the pattern `\d+:\d{2}\.\d{2}`.
After clicking "Lap" once, clicking "Lap" again adds a second list item containing "Lap 2" and a duration string; the list now contains two items.
Clicking the button "Stop" changes the button label to "Start" and the time display stops incrementing; the displayed time remains constant for 2 seconds.
Clicking the button "Reset" clears the time display to "0:00.00" and removes all lap list items, showing the text "No laps yet".
After adding two laps and reloading the page, the lap list still contains items with "Lap 1" and "Lap 2" and their original duration strings.
Clicking the button "Copy laps" copies the lap list to the clipboard; the clipboard content contains "Lap 1" and "Lap 2" with their durations.
Reload keeps the lap list: after adding a lap and reloading, the list item with "Lap 1" and its duration string is still visible.
